question: At what times should worship of the great-souled deity be performed?
premises: Worship should be performed for the great-souled one
It should be done at month’s end
It should be done on every festival
inference: Worship of the great-souled deity should be performed at month’s end and on every festival.
uncertainties: The exact ritual action implied by kuryān is context-dependent.
plain_english: Then one should perform worship for the great-souled one at the end of the month and on every festival.
